## R Markdown
Import data from Statistical packages and from Database Management Systems.

R provides functions and packages that allow you to load data, analyze it, and create visualizations.


### 1. Importing data from statistical packages

Statistical software often saves data in specific file formats.


First, install and load the haven package.

```{r import-stata}
library(haven)

file_path <- "C:\\Users\\hp\\OneDrive\\Rutagengwa's file\\M'sAUCA\\F.SEM\\R\\Assignment\\data\\"
```

### Importing Stata data

```{r import-dta-data}
data <- read_dta(file.path(file_path, "survey.dta"))
View(data)
head(data)
```

```{r}
summary(data)
```

### Importing a CSV file

CSV files are common in statistical analysis.

```{r import-csv-data}
data <- read.csv(file.path(file_path, "students.csv"))

View(data)
```

Get Top 6 rows
```{r}
head(data)
```
Get CSV Summary

```{r}
summary(data)
```
### 2. Importing data from a Database Management System (DBMS)


A DBMS stores structured data in tables. R can connect to a database, execute SQL queries, and retrieve the results into a data frame.
Common database systems include:
- MySQL
- PostgreSQL
- Microsoft SQL Server
- Oracle Database
- SQLite


### Importing data from MySQL

Install the package:


```{r import-mysql-data}
library(DBI)
library(RMariaDB)

con <- dbConnect(
  RMariaDB::MariaDB(),
  dbname = "PayrollDB",
  host = "localhost",
  port = 3306,
  user = "root",
  password = "Password123!"
)

employees <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
      "SELECT e.EmployeeID, d.DepartmentName, p.PositionName, e.EmploymentDate,   e.EmploymentDate, e.Status
     FROM payrolldb.employees e
    JOIN payrolldb.positions p on p.PositionID=e.PositionID
    JOIN payrolldb.departments d on d.DepartmentID=e.DepartmentID
;"
)

View(employees)

dbDisconnect(con)

```

```{r}
head(employees)
```


### 3. Import data from a public API

```{r}

library(jsonlite)

users <- fromJSON(
  "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users"
)

View(users)

```

```{r}
head(users)
```
